source_text: Additional claimed benefits include a 10-fold reduction in urinary tract infections (UTIs) during the first year of life, with meta-analyses estimating an absolute risk reduction from 1% in uncircumcised infants to 0.1% in circumcised ones, potentially averting rare long-term renal damage. [147]
